name: Jake Lowery
quote: Noelle's courteous and accessible nature made my experience with the FredNats truly enjoyable, and her exceptional ability to capture game moments was unmatched.

name: Becky Larkin
role: Chancellor High School Varsity Girls' Soccer Coach
quote: We have loved having Noelle capture some of our special moments on the field over the last few years! Not only are her pictures gorgeous, but she always seems to catch the little moments that show how much it means to be part of a team.

name: Aidan Pinto
quote: Noelle has an incredible talent for capturing the energy and emotion of every game. Every time I look at her photos, it makes every moment unforgettable.

name: Jason Burton
quote: Noelle does high quality work and turns it around extremely quick. [When she worked for PBR], she was on time, responsive, and her work speaks for itself.

name: Billy Fluharty
quote: Noelle brings out the best parts of every game with her camera. My favorite pictures from high school and college have been from Noelle and she reminds me why I love to play the game.

name: Bryan Diehr
role: Randolph-Macon College Former Director of Athletic Communications
quote: Noelle is as talented as they come! She is a treat to work with, brings joy to every event, and creates an impeccable product.

name: Abby Lybarger
quote: Noelle is a pleasure to work with and always comes with the best attitude on and off the field. Her photos have always captured the excitement and beauty of coming to a Fredericksburg Nationals game.

name: Jack Bowles
quote: Noelle does a great job of capturing the moments that really matter. It is so nice to have someone around who shows consistency and positivity in her work.
